visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a brightly lit hotel hallway where a woman wearing a white turtleneck sweater and a bun approaches a door. She appears distressed, holding her head with her hands and swaying unsteadily before leaning against the door frame. (2) A different woman with long dark hair enters a room; she is dressed in a light blue coat over a graphic t-shirt. Her eyes roll back dramatically, and she slumps against the wall as if about to faint. (3) A man in a denim jacket enters the frame next, displaying intense physical agitation. He contorts his face and body in a series of violent sneezing motions, holding a tissue to his nose. (4) A blonde-haired man wearing an orange sweatshirt enters a room cautiously. He looks around with a terrified expression, jumping back at slight movements and holding his backpack straps tightly. (5) A montage follows showing various individuals jumping onto a large white hotel bed. One man performs a high somersault, while another belly-flops onto the mattress, testing its bounce. (6) The final sequence depicts several people struggling to use a hotel key card on a digital reader. They tap, swipe, and shove the card at the device with increasing levels of frustration and erratic gestures.
